harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Inventory web tier completed. node2 and node3 serve the application on port 8080; node1 load-balances port 80 across both using HAProxy round-robin health checks. All nodes passed sequential reboot and recovery verification.
actions_performed: Created persistent inventory.service instances on node2 and node3 using the installed Python 3 runtime.
Configured inventory HTML, JSON API, health endpoint, and backend-identification headers.
Installed HAProxy 3.0.5 from the native CentOS repository on node1 and configured both backends with HTTP health checks.
Persistently opened HTTP/80 on node1 and TCP/8080 on both backends.
Verified remote requests alternate node2, node3, node2, node3.
Rebooted node1, node2, and node3 individually and verified changed boot identities and service/data recovery after each.

evidence.requirement: Preserve the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: All nodes began on CentOS Stream 10 with kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64; final verification still reports that kernel.

evidence.requirement: Run the inventory application on node2 port 8080
evidence.summary: inventory.service is enabled and active, listens on 0.0.0.0:8080, and returns node2 inventory data before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Run the inventory application on node3 port 8080
evidence.summary: inventory.service is enabled and active, listens on 0.0.0.0:8080, and returns node3 inventory data before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Load-balance node1 port 80 across both backends
evidence.summary: HAProxy is enabled and active on 0.0.0.0:80. Local and remote request traces return HTTP 200 and alternate node2/node3; the inventory HTML and all items remain available.

Healthy baseline and reboot acknowledgement were captured. Boot ID changed from 21de1f79-e793-4c36-923a-f4af0bbea55e to 36637893-2f8c-40f9-9bb8-0ffa57b6c168; HAProxy recovered and served both backends.

Healthy baseline and reboot acknowledgement were captured. Boot ID changed from 83a0a80f-773c-4f3e-9137-1e7aa887b07a to a548a779-683c-4d0f-ae76-70ff6ce2ac77; inventory data recovered and node2 rejoined load-balancer rotation.

Healthy baseline and reboot acknowledgement were captured. Boot ID changed from 5e93a57c-0d8d-454e-8fb1-617b2a46810c to 44f40541-add5-4dea-ad1e-04b1c8b56ee4; inventory data recovered and node3 rejoined load-balancer rotation.
